thread:
Maya Ortiz: Heads-up: Product wants a compact social push around our April webinar (Serving at Scale). Need X + LinkedIn cadence, 3 short thread concepts, asset checklist, and engagement playbook by EOD Thursday.
Liam Hsu: I can take X threads. Clarify audience: infra+platform engineers, and a secondary exec ROI angle?
Maya Ortiz: Primary = infra/ML infra. Secondary = platform leads. Tone = crisp, data-first, with a clear webinar CTA.
Ravi Kothari: Benchmark angle preferred: p95 / cost per 1k tokens / throughput. Also we should have one "how-we-did-it" migration thread.
Zoe Kim: I'll own LinkedIn formats and the asset pack (images, short video clip, carousel). Need thread drafts by tomorrow AM to adapt.
Liam Hsu: Draft concepts:
-- Thread 1 (Benchmark highlight): 1/ We cut p95 from 450ms to 190ms with batching + kernel changes (chart). 2/ 30% unit cost drop with prefix caching. 3/ Join the webinar for configs. #inference #llmops
-- Thread 2 (Throughput playbook): 1/ Serving 1.5k req/s inside cost targets. 2/ Autoscale + quantization rules we used. 3/ Webinar: live demo + Q&A.
-- Thread 3 (Migration brief): 1/ Zero-downtime move from hosted -> dedicated pools. 2/ Routing/fallbacks that saved the day. 3/ Register for rollout checklist.
Zoe Kim: Good. For LinkedIn: Thread 1 becomes a 3-card carousel; Thread 2 is a short post + link to benchmark blog; Thread 3 is a customer quote + CTA. I'll need high-res PNGs and the short 20s clip.
Maya Ortiz: Asset checklist: latency_chart.png, cost_chart.png, migration_diagram.svg, 20s_demo.mp4, 3x carousel images, suggested captions (short). Also include 3 canned replies and an FAQ snippet for SDRs.
SchedulerBot: Reminder created: "Prep webinar social assets" due 2026-04-01T23:59:00Z.
Ravi Kothari: I'll export charts today and a CSV of numbers. Also adding a 1-paragraph benchmark note for the post thread.
Liam Hsu: I'll draft the X copy and 6 suggested replies (welcome, ask for use-case, invite to trial, link to benchmark, ask for meeting, thanks). Will post drafts here by 09:00 UTC tomorrow.
Zoe Kim: I'll assemble assets and upload a zip to the drive, plus alt-text and captions, by EOD Thursday. Sheet: https://docs.google.com/spreadsheets/d/marketing-social-sched (edit for marketing+ops).
Maya Ortiz: Inbound routing: webinar form should tag "webinar_apr_2026" and set HubSpot list "webinar_apr_2026_regs". SDR follow-up SLA: 24h for leads with "interested_in_dedicated" checked.
Ravi Kothari: Adding hidden utm fields and a recommended field list: name, email, company, role, expected_monthly_tps, interested_in_dedicated (checkbox).
Liam Hsu: Live-day plan: post X thread at T0, follow-ups at +15m and +45m. Live monitoring rota: Ravi 0-30m, Liam 30-60m, Zoe LinkedIn comments 0-60m.
Maya Ortiz: Great. Can someone draft two short CTAs for the registration flow (one technical, one exec)?
Zoe Kim: Technical CTA: "See configs & live Q&A on latency and cost tradeoffs \t6 April webinar". Exec CTA: "Learn how to make inference predictable & cost-efficient \t6 sign up".
Liam Hsu: I'll also prep a short thread variant aimed at platform execs with topline ROI numbers.
Maya Ortiz: Final ask: confirm the publish times in the sheet and set crosspost to LinkedIn via the scheduler. Notify comms when drafts and assets ready.
SchedulerBot: Post queued: X thread at 2026-04-06T14:00:00Z (awaiting assets).
Ravi Kothari: Uploading charts to drive now and will drop the CSV link here when done.
Zoe Kim: I'll upload assets by EOD Thursday and ping this thread.
Liam Hsu: Will post draft copies by 09:00 UTC.
Maya Ortiz: Thanks team 44D Close loop once live and share engagement highlights after 2 hours.
